integrity: All five dynamical equations and the all-parameter Jacobian/Routh calculations are stated. Standalone exact-algebra checks are corroborative. Publication-priority overlap with generalized spectral results remains a residual risk; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to balanced encounter mixing, resonant feedback ratios and frequency-dependent affine payoff differences with 0<B<A<C, and describes full-interior equilibria and local dynamics only. The symmetric case gives a linear imaginary pair, not a nonlinear periodic-orbit theorem. No global basin or boundary-equilibrium classification is claimed.
title: Sharp transverse damping of a resonant two-community environmental-feedback game
